chapter: Ellington, the South, bebop and radio
title: Jam sessions as exchanging ideas
summary: Sessions let players learn what others were doing and trade ideas, like a seminar, and are now rare.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We were talking about sessions at Monroe's and things like that. Those kinds of sessions are pretty much a thing of the past now.
Yeah, they are. You don't see too many of those.
Did they provide you with an opportunity to play in the kind of way that you might not have gotten anywhere else?

Well, they give you a chance to learn what the other guy is doing. You've got to use a little of what he's got with your stuff, and you maybe can come up with something that's another monster. Or angel. Either way you want to look at it.
So in other words, it's like a kind of conversation between...
It's out there exchanging ideas. Exchanging ideas.
Well, it's kind of sad, in a way, that that doesn't exist any more. Because some people don't listen to each other as much as they should..
